## Change and motivation

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Link the relevant issue if any.

## Validation

List commands/results and any untested platform or feature. Explain compatibility,
security, dependency/license and documentation impact where applicable.

## Contribution provenance

Confirm you can explain and maintain this change and have the right to contribute it.
List copied/adapted sources and licenses. Disclose substantive AI assistance as
required by AI_POLICY.md; no private prompts, credentials or assistant commit credits.
